# Get Image Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given image.

## Syntax

~~~~text
imageDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, image: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
imageDetail(detail: Width, image: Avatar)
~~~~
